tests.instructions: One assessment per chapter grouping plus a final exam. Every question maps to the section shown in brackets so you can revise precisely.

questions.q: Which concept makes gofmt behave that way? (Go ch.1)
The worked sample prints "Hello, Go". Which statement caused it? (ch.1)
Which concept makes go.mod behave that way? (Go ch.2)
The worked sample prints "go.mod created with module path". Which statement caused it? (ch.2)
Which concept makes struct behave that way? (Go ch.3)
The worked sample prints "Returns total plus 5% tax". Which statement caused it? (ch.3)
Which concept makes interface{} behave that way? (Go ch.4)
The worked sample prints "Any value with Error() string satisfies error". Which statement caused it? (ch.4)
Which concept makes go func behave that way? (Go ch.5)
The worked sample prints "Values flow between goroutines". Which statement caused it? (ch.5)
Which concept makes net/http behave that way? (Go ch.6)
The worked sample prints "Serves requests on :8080". Which statement caused it? (ch.6)
Which concept makes middleware behave that way? (Go ch.7)
The worked sample prints "In-flight requests drain before exit". Which statement caused it? (ch.7)
